invariants.rationale: instantTime is expected to be a valid identifier for the commit instant, which typically must not be null.
The method requires a list of records to process; a null value would likely cause failure.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is necessary for executing data pipeline operations.
If preppedRecords is not empty, its size must be non-negative; List.size() is always >= 0.
Option<BulkInsertPartitioner> must be a valid Option instance, even if it may not contain a value.
